deniedGlobals.Date: packages/app confines wall-clock/Intl/random APIs to src/adapters/ (ADR-0008, D8): use the injected Clock/TimeZone port instead.
deniedGlobals.Intl: packages/app confines Intl to src/adapters/ (ADR-0008, D8): use the injected TimeZone port instead.
deniedGlobals.Math: packages/app must not use Math.random or float math outside adapters: use the injected RandomSource port, and @pactjoy/engine's exact Fraction arithmetic for anything scored.
deniedGlobals.Temporal: packages/app confines time APIs to src/adapters/ (ADR-0008, D8): use the injected Clock/TimeZone port instead.
deniedGlobals.crypto: packages/app confines crypto to src/adapters/ (ADR-0008, D9): use the injected IdGenerator/RandomSource port instead.

patterns.message: Import only the '@pactjoy/engine' package root (its public index.ts) -- deep imports leak internal engine modules and break the high-decoupling boundary (CLAUDE.md, ADR-0008).
packages/app is standard TypeScript/ESM: 'npm:' specifiers are Deno-specific and not portable across runtimes (ADR-0007/ADR-0008).
packages/app is standard TypeScript/ESM: 'jsr:' specifiers are Deno-specific and not portable across runtimes (ADR-0007/ADR-0008).
